verdict.rationale: Steel publishes dedicated integration docs for the Claude Agent SDK (in-process MCP tools), the Vercel AI SDK, and CrewAI (as a CrewAI tool), plus adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, AgentKit, Pydantic AI and Pi. That covers three of the four named frameworks with documented adapters. missing for 10: no evidence of a LangChain adapter, no independent or hands-on corroboration that the integrations work as documented.
